name: Essence of Movement (Akashic)
body:
You flow through the battlefield, nimbly evading the blows of your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Dex 13, Dodge.

Benefit(s): You get a +1 dodge bonus to armor class against attacks of opportunity caused when you move out of or within a threatened area, plus an additional +1 per point of essence invested in this feat. In addition, you gain a +1 insight bonus per point of essence invested on all Acrobatics checks. A condition that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to armor class (if any) also makes you lose the dodge and acrobatics bonuses. This feat counts as Mobility for determining prerequisites.

You gain 1 point of essence.
